sql: SELECT T2.name, T3.name, T4.name, T5.bool FROM person T1 LEFT JOIN unemployed T2 ON T1.name = T2.name LEFT JOIN disabled T3 ON T1.name = T3.name LEFT JOIN male T4 ON T1.name = T4.name LEFT JOIN no_payment_due T5 ON T1.name = T5.name WHERE T1.name IN ('student180', 'student117')
SELECT CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM disabled WHERE name NOT IN (SELECT name FROM male)) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM disabled WHERE name IN (SELECT name FROM male))
SELECT T1.name FROM filed_for_bankrupcy T1 INNER JOIN no_payment_due T2 ON T1.name = T2.name WHERE T2.bool = 'neg'
SELECT COUNT(T1.name) FROM unemployed T1 INNER JOIN disabled T2 ON T1.name = T2.name INNER JOIN longest_absense_from_school T3 ON T1.name = T3.name WHERE T3.month = 8
